literal: Than sulking, celestial land is there? with earth water having blended those who are like - in the heart.
translation: Is there a heaven sweeter than the lovers' sulking, when their hearts are blended like water with the earth?
modern: நிலத்தோடு நீர் கலந்திருப்பதைப் போல அன்பால் கலந்த காதலர்களின் நெஞ்சத்தில் தோன்றும் ஊடலை விட இன்பமான தேவர் உலகம் வேறு இருக்கிறதா?
explanation: The couplet compares the union of lovers to the blending of water with the earth, an inseparable and natural bond. It asks whether even the celestial world of the gods could offer a joy greater than the lovers' feigned anger (sulking). The word 'புலத்தல்' refers to this delicate, temporary sulking that only deepens their affection. The imagery of earth and water highlights how their hearts are completely absorbed in each other.
